prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save your pet's progress", "Sign in to keep your new desktop pet safe and synced across devices."]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Here is how to interact, hide, and summon your pet on your desktop screen.", "Master Pet Controls", "Click pet to chat • Right-click menu to hide • Drag to relocate"]
2: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your companion details and sign your adoption agreement."]
3: ["Choose Your Companion", "Select an archetype and see them come to life on stage.", "Preset & Custom Archetypes", "Live Pet Preview"]
4: ["Summoning your pet to your desktop...", "We are preparing your pet's desktop behaviors and animations.", "Tip: Drag your pet anywhere on your desktop screen once loaded!", "Setting up desktop collision bounds..."]
5: ["Secure Your Pet & Unlock Starter Crown", "Signing in ensures your pet memories and custom accessories are backed up securely.", "Free Golden Crown Included", "Cloud Backup Enabled: Prevents pet loss or resets"]
6: ["How would you like to adopt today?", "Choose a ready-to-play pet for instant desktop fun, or create a unique custom pet from your photos.", "You can always adopt more pets later!"]
7: ["Pet is getting ready in the background!", "Feel free to work or browse. We will ping your desktop as soon as your companion appears.", "Notify Me When Ready"]
8: ["Pet missing? Check your taskbar tray icon or press Ctrl+Alt+P to summon your pet to the active monitor.", "Multi-Monitor Ready", "Click system tray icon if pet hides behind active app windows."]
9: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Compare fast instant adoption with our custom creation kit.", "Instant Companion (1-Min Setup)", "Custom Companion (Photo Upload)"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and gifts (Starter Crown/Free Golden Crown) to entice users to sign in.
